```{r}

# Functions

theme_Publication <- function(base_size=14) {
      library(grid)
      library(ggthemes)
      (theme_foundation(base_size=base_size)
       + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                         size = rel(1.2), hjust = 0.5),
               text = element_text(),
               panel.background = element_rect(colour = NA),
               plot.background = element_rect(colour = NA),
               panel.border = element_rect(colour = NA),
               axis.title = element_text(face = "bold",size = rel(1)),
               axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90,vjust =2),
               axis.title.x = element_text(vjust = -0.2),
               axis.text = element_text(), 
               axis.line = element_line(colour="black"),
               axis.ticks = element_line(),
               panel.grid.major = element_line(colour="#f0f0f0"),
               panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
               legend.key = element_rect(colour = NA),
               legend.position = "bottom",
               legend.direction = "horizontal",
               legend.key.size= unit(0.2, "cm"),
               legend.margin = unit(0, "cm"),
               legend.title = element_text(face="italic"),
               plot.margin=unit(c(10,5,5,5),"mm"),
               strip.background=element_rect(colour="#f0f0f0",fill="#f0f0f0"),
               strip.text = element_text(face="bold")
          ))
      
}

scale_fill_Publication <- function(...){
      library(scales)
      discrete_scale("fill","Publication",manual_pal(values = c("#386cb0","#fdb462","#7fc97f","#ef3b2c","#662506","#a6cee3","#fb9a99","#984ea3","#ffff33")), ...)

}

scale_colour_Publication <- function(...){
      library(scales)
      discrete_scale("colour","Publication",manual_pal(values = c("#386cb0","#fdb462","#7fc97f","#ef3b2c","#662506","#a6cee3","#fb9a99","#984ea3","#ffff33")), ...)
      
}
```

```{r}

data <- read_csv("/Users/luiza/Projects/ERIM/Study_3/bcpe_study3.csv") %>% 
  mutate_at(c("Condition", "gender", "race", "edu", "party"), as.factor) %>% 
  mutate(age = ifelse(age == 1982, 2020 - 1982, age)) %>% 
  drop_na(
    party,
    edu,
    race,
    gender,
    age,
    bcpe,
    coop,
    animosity,
    md,
    sd,
    out_emp_pref,
    out_emp,
    in_emp_pref,
    in_emp,
    pol_id
  ) %>% 
  mutate(age_centered = scale(age, scale = FALSE))

mean(data$age)
sd(data$age)

table(data$gender)
table(data$race)
table(data$att_check)
```

## Modeling

Models used to create Table 2

```{r}

data_bcpe <- data %>%  
  group_by(Condition) %>% 
  summarize(mean_bcpe = mean(bcpe, na.rm = T),
            sd_bcpe = sd(bcpe, na.rm = T)
            )

model <- lm(scale(bcpe) ~ relevel(Condition, ref = "Control") + age_centered + relevel(gender, ref = "0") + edu + pol_id + race, data = data)
summary(model)
confint(model)

model <- lm(scale(coop) ~ relevel(Condition, ref = "Low Utility") + age_centered + relevel(gender, ref = "0") + edu + pol_id + race, data = data)
summary(model)
confint(model)
```

## Visualization

```{r}

plotallDVs_df <- 
  data %>% 
  dplyr::select(Condition, sd, coop, md, animosity) %>% 
  mutate(
    sd = scale(sd),
    coop = scale(coop),
    md = scale(md),
    animosity = scale(animosity)
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Condition,
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "values"
  )


plotallDVs_df %>% 
  ggplot(aes(values, type, fill = fct_rev(Condition))) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_se", geom = "linerange", size = 0.5) +
  stat_summary(fun.y = "mean", shape = 21, geom = "point", size = 5) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = c("sd", "md", "animosity", "coop"),
                   labels = c("coop" = "Bipartisan Cooperation",
                              "animosity" = "Outparty Animosity",
                              "md" = "Moral Disengagement",
                              "sd" = "Social Distance" 
                              )) + 
  labs(
    title = "Reading about High (vs Low)\nUtility of Cross-Partisan Empathy\nReduces Measures of Partisan Division",
    y = NULL,
    x = "Standarized Ratings",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
   theme_Publication()

```

```{r}
## Mediations

## Animosity
modelTE <- lm(scale(animosity) ~ 1 + cond, data = data)
round(coefficients(summary(modelTE)), 2)
modelS1 <- lm(scale(bcpe) ~ 1 + cond, data = data)
round(coefficients(summary(modelS1)), 2)
modelS2 <- lm(scale(animosity) ~ 1 + cond + scale(bcpe), data = data)
round(coefficients(summary(modelS2)), 2)

set.seed(1)
.bootstrapping <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- data[indices, , drop = FALSE] # allows boot to select sample
  modelS1 <- lm(scale(bcpe) ~ 1 + cond, data = d)
  modelS2 <- lm(scale(animosity) ~ 1 + cond + scale(bcpe), data = d)
  indEff <- unname(coef(modelS1)[2]*coef(modelS2)[3])
  return(indEff)
}

bootstrap.summary <- boot::boot(data = data, statistic = .bootstrapping, R = 5000)
bootstrap.summary
bootstrap.ci1 <- boot::boot.ci(bootstrap.summary, type = "bca", conf = 0.95, index = 1)
bootstrap.ci1
```
